_comment: Single source of truth for the Binyamin English brand mark. The installed Android PWA icon is the canonical treatment (teal rounded tile + a geometric white B built from a stem and two open bowls). Both the PNG generator (scripts/gen-icons.mjs) and the in-app <BrandMark> SVG read these numbers, so the launcher icon, the favicon and the header monogram can never drift apart. All glyph values are normalized 0..1 fractions of the icon's edge.
